label_isolation: each held-out building map is reused for ALL training and test teams; no target-building history in labels/profiles
prediction_mean: source panel mean, never target panel mean
training_response: target panel centered deviation only in outside-building training; target evaluation centered values never fit
regularization: fixed standardized ridge 0.01; no target tuning
continuous_comparator: source deviation; five historical means; source-only fitted linear/quadratic ridge response (degree/penalty chosen by source-only LOOCV); full continuous model includes all
status: internal building-held-out response comparison in the same registered finite design
